result.scope: Read-only port-filtered ss; ss may internally use namespace /proc fallback. Only sockets owned by the explicit verified node PID and stable FD/inode before/after are retained. rb/tb are Linux kernel memory limits, often doubled relative to requested SO_RCVBUF/SO_SNDBUF; not exact payload capacity. No peer, raw ss output, stderr, uid, cookie, environment, capture, attach or mutation is archived.
